cds.title: Sarah Lawrence College Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class): 4,085 applied, 2,694 admitted (66.0%), 350 enrolled; the residency rows (in-state 761/465, out-of-state 2,656/1,988, international 668/241) add up to the totals. International (nonresident) first-years: 668 applied, 241 admitted, 32 enrolled. Waitlist: 890 offered a place, 450 accepted, 169 admitted. The ED figure (117 applied, 58 admitted) covers Early Decision only; the CDS gives no count for Early Action. Only 9% (40 students) of enrolled first-years submitted SAT and 3% (12) submitted ACT, so the test ranges below rest on very small groups (the CDS SAT composite 75th percentile of 1378 is even below its share of 25% scoring 1400-1600). The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column; 85% of first-years reported a GPA. Enrollment 1,390 and nonresidents 75 are the degree-seeking undergraduate figures (B1/B2); total undergraduates including non-degree students are 1,447 (86 nonresidents).

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set G1/G5. The CDS asks for 2026-27 and ticks '2026-27 costs not available' (final costs about 4/1), yet the college's tuition page for 2026-27 shows the same preliminary figures: tuition $73,088 (12-18 credits per semester), required fees $612 (student activities $250 + wellness $362), food and housing $20,316 (room $13,354 + required first-year meal plan $6,962). Estimated expenses: books $600, transportation $100, other $800 (other costs shown = transportation + other). Per-credit tuition $2,438. The college's international cost-of-attendance table (2026-27) adds health insurance $4,948 and budgets transportation at $2,000, for an estimated total of $102,364. Common Data Set H6: need-based and non-need-based institutional aid is available to nonresidents; 69 degree-seeking nonresidents received it (average $50,153)
